why.body: You noted that CeraVe PM feels heavy on your face despite helping with dryness. Testing the candidate moisturizer is a direct way to see if another formulation provides a lighter feel.
why.title: Addressing persistent heaviness

why.body: Because a past lightweight gel left your skin feeling tight by morning, you need a product that balances a comfortable feel without sacrificing overnight hydration.
why.title: Maintaining adequate moisture

value.reason: Although CeraVe PM effectively reduces your dryness, it feels too heavy on your skin. A trial of the Vanicream moisturizer allows you to evaluate whether it offers a more comfortable face feel while still maintaining the moisture your skin needs.
value.headline: Try Vanicream Daily Facial Moisturizer to address the heavy feel of CeraVe PM
value.nextStep: Apply Vanicream Daily Facial Moisturizer to your face in place of CeraVe PM, monitoring morning hydration and skin feel over several days.

tradeoffs.body: CeraVe PM is confirmed to improve your dryness, whereas manufacturer marketing claims of being lightweight or rich do not guarantee how well the new formula will retain moisture on your skin.
tradeoffs.title: Potential loss of dryness relief
